PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch. A Stop hook flags when a 24h memory consolidation is due, per project, and a SessionStart hook nudges the next session to run /dream. A UserPromptSubmit hook recalls the memories relevant to each prompt, ranking the project's memory notes with BM25 and injecting nothing when nothing clears the score floor. A second Stop hook keeps a dated session ledger under the memory directory so consolidation knows which transcripts to read. /pro-dev-doctor health-checks an installed marketplace (plugin coverage, strict validation, routing smoke check).
